name: nexa-agent
description: Multi-agent orchestrator v2 for NexaChess. Not an npm workspace member -- root workspaces globs are apps/* and packages/* only.
_type_note: Deliberately no "type" field: ts-node needs CommonJS (tsconfig sets module:commonjs, and Node defaults to CommonJS without this field), while Turbopack refuses to bundle ESM-syntax .ts from a package that explicitly declares commonjs. Absent satisfies both.
